subject.title: [Bug] QQ Bot: skill_workshop approval "Allow" button always recorded as rejected

question: Should delivery of a fallback approval card in a QQ C2C conversation itself authorize that callback actor, or must approval authority remain explicitly configured through `allowFrom` or `execApprovals.approvers`?
rationale: Current code and docs deliberately fail closed, while the linked PR broadens privileged approval authority for open direct-message configurations; source evidence cannot choose that security and product tradeoff.

options.title: Keep explicit authorization
options.body: Preserve the current gate and add an in-product setup or recovery action for assigning the C2C OpenID as an approval-only approver.

options.title: Trust C2C card recipients
options.body: Treat a direct-chat callback actor as authorized after live QQ evidence proves the card and actor identity are securely one-to-one bound.

options.title: Add an opt-in mode
options.body: Retain the secure default while offering an explicit QQ policy for operators who want C2C delivery to confer approval authority.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit authorization
recommendation.body: Preserve the current gate and add an in-product setup or recovery action for assigning the C2C OpenID as an approval-only approver.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history shows the strongest direct ownership of the current command-auth alignment and approval security contract.
